maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new aircraft (Cessna, Beechcraft, Bell), defense systems, E-Z-GO vehicles and Kautex fuel systems; aftermarket is a smaller share.

publicly_funded.reason: Largest segments are Textron Aviation business jets and industrial products sold to private buyers; Bell and Textron Systems government work is a minority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own aircraft, defense and industrial product sales; acquisitions like Pipistrel are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Certified aircraft, Lycoming engines, and defense systems are qualified and regulated, so switching involves re-certification and high disruption.

notes: Bell is roughly comparable in size to Textron Aviation, so the government-funded share is uncertain, though it is likely under half.
